description: This file defines a Java interface 'MappingFunction' that extends the 'Function' interface, providing methods for mapping data objects and constructing exceptions related to JavaScript message mapping errors within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: MappingFunction
classes.description: A functional interface extending Java's Function interface, specialized for mapping input data to output data with a method for creating detailed exception objects when JavaScript mapping errors occur.

methods.name: buildMessageMappingFailedException
methods.description: Constructs a MessageMappingFailedException using details from a RhinoException, including message, line source, script stack trace, and related message headers.
